comment.body:
> @joshenders 
> Disable Adblock Warning Removal List
> Enable AdGuard Tracking Protection Filter and EasyPrivacy

That worked. No longer able to reproduce the issue. Thank you!

Here's my currently enabled list after the change:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b2d5e526-3a9f-4222-9d59-b9d8b890d023)
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6fef32e4-3bb6-4e89-b97b-af9e78aee30f)

For anyone who got here from a search engine: tap the shield icon in the AdGuard for iOS app > Safari Protection > Filters. Tracking Protection Filter and EasyPrivacy are under `Privacy`, Adblock warning removal is under `Annoyances`.

fwiw it wasn't immediately obvious to me that clicking this circled item in the screenshot below opened up further menu pages. This is an unusual pattern for iOS.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e3b1e909-8654-4f13-8365-3ee592852a7b)

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://myactivity.google.com/product/youtube_comments?hl=en-GB&utm_medium=web&utm_source=youtube](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmyactivity.google.com%2Fproduct%2Fyoutube_comments%3Fhl%3Den-GB%26utm_medium%3Dweb%26utm_source%3Dyoutube) ### Comment > Issue only occurs when visiting activity via YouTube, visiting the link directly **cannot reproduce the issue**. > > ### Steps: > > 1.
